description: This file defines path-related functions and constants for use within a C project, specifically for managing storage location paths such as dynamic, static, configuration, and statistics directories on an embedded device. It includes function prototypes for retrieving various paths based on properties or defaults, and defines constant path macros.
external_files: <possibly other source files that implement these functions>
Existing headers or property management libraries
external_methods: None explicitly called within the header, but functions are declared for external implementation

methods.name: getDynamicPath
methods.description: Returns the path to dynamic files, defaulting to /opt, caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getDynamicConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the path to dynamic config files, defaulting to /opt/etc, caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getStaticPath
methods.description: Returns the static files path, defaulting to /vendor, caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getStaticConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the static config files path, defaulting to /vendor/etc, caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getBrandDefaultsPath
methods.description: Returns the path to default configurations for the firmware brand; caller must free the string.

methods.name: getStatisticPath
methods.description: Returns the path for statistics files; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getTelemetryPath
methods.description: Returns the path for telemetry files; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getPropertyAsPath
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a path string, or returns a default value if undefined; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getCABundlePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the trusted CA bundle in PEM format.
